title: Decision support briefing (one page)
description: A one-page impact-based decision support briefing: bottom line, timing, impacts, confidence and the decisions the partner faces. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

examples: Issued 1:30 PM EDT Wed Oct 21 2026 by Kowalski, NWS Wilmington OH
A line of severe thunderstorms will cross Haldane County between 3 PM and 8 PM today. Damaging winds and a few tornadoes are the primary threats.
First storms enter the west end of the county

examples.event: First storms enter the west end of the county

examples: Damaging winds to 70 mph: trees and power lines down, outages likely
Damaging winds to 70 mph: trees and power lines down, outages likely
High confidence in timing. Medium confidence in tornado potential; a watch is likely.

decisionPoints.description: Decisions the partner will face (up to 4)

examples: Whether to open the shelter at the fairgrounds

examples.decision: Whether to open the shelter at the fairgrounds

examples: Next briefing 4:00 PM on the partner call; ILN duty phone is in the partner directory.
